observations.body: Moses carries God-worked, God-written tablets down, sees calf and dancing, breaks the tablets, destroys the calf, confronts Aaron, and hears Aaron’s account.
observations.label: The tablets break beneath the mountain

observations.body: The tablets break beneath the mountain belongs to breach and intercession in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 32:15–24 supplies aftermath evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: The calf, judgment, intercession, threatened absence, and restored presence remain one damaged sequence without being collapsed into an easy resolution.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 32:15–24 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The tablets break beneath the mountain belongs to the breach and intercession movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The tablets break beneath the mountain
